meaning:
δυσφημέω, -ώ
(δύσφημος, slanderous), [in LXX: 1Ma.7:41 * ;]
1. intrans., to use evil words (Æsch.).
2. Trans., to speak ill of, defame (Soph.): pass., 1Co.4:13.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.
